assumptions.fee_allocation: end_of_day_in_range_indicator; intraday crossing and token fee balances not reconstructed
assumptions.fees_currency: USD cash, not reinvested; ignores token fee balance exposure
assumptions.gas: flat user assumption, opening 1 + closing 1 + 2 per recenter
limitations: No historical active-L or fee-growth reconstruction
TVL reporting lag assumed, not archived publication vintage
No historical protocol fee changes, MEV/JIT or market impact
Daily endpoints miss intraday fee attribution
No 2022-2024 pool price/volume sample for calibration
assumptions.quote_usd: ETHUSDT historical close proxy for quote/USD; USDT/USD = 1 assumption.
assumptions.rebalance: on prior close after an out-of-range observation; new range earns from next bar; fixed initial width
assumptions.slippage: bps times recentered USD inventory, separate cash cost
assumptions.solvency_constraint: Not imposed: cash costs can make total wealth negative; Sharpe/Sortino then null.
assumptions.volume: realized daily pool volume; not a CEX volume
